To strengthen the evaluation, the authors should conduct experiments where all methods are evaluated using the same set of pre-trained models. For instance, the baselines should also be allowed to use the same VLM for parameter estimation or a similar mechanism for incorporating prior knowledge. Furthermore, the authors should provide a more detailed analysis of the individual contributions of each component in their pipeline, such as the 3D representation generation, physical simulator, and video diffusion model-based refinement.
